title: Backend part 1: add missing role, YouTube verification, suggestions, and comments APIs

requirements.text: Implement a backend API `getCallerUserRole()` that returns the caller role as a text value compatible with the frontend checks (e.g., "admin", "user", "guest"). Use the existing authorization/access-control state already included in `backend/main.mo` (MixinAuthorization + AccessControl).
acceptanceCriteria: Calling `getCallerUserRole()` from the frontend returns a stable role string and does not trap for anonymous callers (returns "guest" when not authenticated/authorized).
Admin principals receive "admin"; normal permitted users receive "user".

requirements.text: Implement a backend API for YouTube subscription verification that the frontend mutation `useSetYouTubeVerified` can call (e.g., `setYouTubeVerified()`), which updates the caller's `UserProfile` by setting `isYouTubeVerified = true` and setting `youtubeVerificationTimestamp = ?Time.now()` without requiring the frontend to pass any parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: If the caller has an existing `UserProfile`, calling the API updates the stored profile fields (`isYouTubeVerified`, `youtubeVerificationTimestamp`) and returns successfully.
If the caller does not have a profile yet, the API returns a clear error (trap) indicating the profile must be created first.
After a successful call, `getCallerUserProfile()` returns the updated values.

requirements.text: Add backend suggestion APIs backed by the existing `suggestions` map in `backend/main.mo`: (1) submit a suggestion (author text + feedback text, assign incremental id + timestamp), (2) list all suggestions with total count, and (3) delete a suggestion by id (admin-only). Ensure the return shape for listing matches the existing backend type `SuggestionsResponse` ({ suggestions : [Suggestion]; count : Nat }).
acceptanceCriteria: A non-admin authenticated caller can submit a suggestion and it is persisted with a unique id and timestamp.
An admin can list suggestions and receives both the array and the correct count.
An admin can delete a suggestion by id; non-admin deletion attempts trap with an unauthorized error.
The APIs compile and are exposed in the generated candid so the frontend actor can call them.

requirements.text: Add backend comment APIs backed by the existing `comments` map in `backend/main.mo`: (1) list comments for a given `questionId`, (2) post a comment for a question (text, assigns incremental id, stores caller principal as userId, sets timestamp), and (3) delete a comment by id. Deletion must be allowed for admins; non-admin deletion must be rejected. Use the existing public `Comment` type in `backend/main.mo` for compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: `getCommentsByQuestion(questionId)` returns all comments associated with that question id (empty array if none).
`postComment(questionId, text)` persists a new comment with a unique id, caller principal as userId, and a timestamp; subsequent listing includes it.
`deleteComment(commentId)` removes the comment if it exists; admin-only (non-admin attempts trap).
All new APIs compile in the single-actor `backend/main.mo` backend and are available to the frontend actor bindings.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; do not introduce additional backend services.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui/*`.
Only add `backend/migration.mo` if an upgrade-safe state migration is required; otherwise, keep migration unchanged/absent.
nonGoals: Implementing question gallery query APIs beyond the already-present `deleteQuestion`.
Implementing PDF export features (currently placeholders on the frontend).
